description: Create a free, no-card ClaraConverts trial for a website, with every Pro feature (voice conversations included). Returns a working embed snippet and a bearer token for follow-up calls (get_embed_snippet, get_upgrade_link). Trial lasts 30 days. One live trial per owner_email — provisioning multiple sites (e.g. for an agency's clients) isn't supported by these tools yet; each site needs its own contact email for now.

conversion_goal.description: Optional: what Clara should drive (e.g. "book a demo", "capture a lead").

display_name.description: Optional display name for the business.

owner_email.description: The site owner's real, monitored email (required). The Studio login link and trial-expiry reminders go only to this address.

site_url.description: URL of the site Clara will be installed on (required).
